generation.transport: Ollama loopback /api/generate; no proxy or redirects
generation.other_options: Ollama defaults remain; identity and explicit options do not guarantee deterministic outputs.

input_serialization: Prompt bytes followed by newline and json.dumps({id, question, sources, allowed_next_step}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True). Do not send evidence_contract, rubric, expected answers or unrelated memory to the model.
schedule: Ascending case IDs, repetitions 1, 2, 3 per case; baseline then candidate for each scheduled slot. No tools, retrieval, company database or network outside loopback.
candidate_state: Not implemented or frozen. BE-49 must freeze candidate prompt, JSON schema, adapter/checker source hashes and complete request settings after development tuning and before any held-out generation. No held-out run authorized by this manifest alone.
baseline_state: Prompt and settings frozen; zero outputs generated.
held_out_state: Zero generations or repairs. Authored and visible to implementer; not a blind external benchmark.
contamination_rule: Record all inspected generation IDs and repair use in an append-only private ledger. A held-out case used for repair moves to development; never rewrite this freeze. Create a new version with genuinely new replacement cases and disclose contamination. Freeze successor before running. All old results remain.
run_gate: Validate hashes and disjoint splits; re-resolve installed model digest before and after generation; freeze run Git SHA and candidate assets before held-out. Reject or label changed identity/configuration, changed assets, missing freeze or prior repair use. Retain aborted partial runs.
retention: Raw outputs/errors and owner comments: ignored owner-only audit-results, 30-day retention under existing policy. Durable non-sensitive provenance, hashes and aggregate counts remain. No public business input, remote inference, downloads or spending.
